name: Data Parallelism (DDP)
description: Replicate model on each GPU, split data, average gradients via all-reduce.
whenToUse: Model fits on one GPU; you want speed.
rule: If one GPU OOMs, DDP changes nothing - shard instead.
failureModes: Missing distributed sampler (all ranks same data); comm-bound on small models/slow links.

name: Fully Sharded Data Parallel
description: PyTorch's ZeRO-like implementation. Shards model, gradients, and optimizer states across GPUs.
whenToUse: Model exceeds one GPU; PyTorch-native stack.
rule: Start FULL_SHARD + per-block wrapping; HYBRID across slow inter-node links.
failureModes: All-gather storms from per-linear wrapping; checkpoint/world-size skew on load.

name: DeepSpeed ZeRO
description: Microsoft's sharded data parallelism. Stages 1-3 progressively shard more state.
whenToUse: Need DeepSpeed offload/kernels, or established ZeRO recipes.
rule: Smallest stage that fits; stage 2 is often the efficiency sweet spot.
failureModes: Stage-3 comm cost accepted blindly; offload thrash misread as slow GPUs.

name: Tensor Parallelism
description: Split individual layer operations across GPUs. Requires fast interconnect (NVLink).
whenToUse: Model too wide for one GPU (esp. inference); layers must split.
rule: TP inside one NVLink domain only; kv_heads divisible by TP degree.
failureModes: TP over PCIe (per-layer syncs strangle throughput); head-count indivisibility.

name: Pipeline Parallelism
description: Split model layers across GPUs in sequence. Different micro-batches on different GPUs.
whenToUse: Very deep models; combined with TP across nodes.
failureModes: Too few micro-batches (idle bubble); uneven stage times gating the pipe.

name: Expert Parallelism
description: Each GPU hosts a subset of MoE experts; tokens route via all-to-all.
whenToUse: MoE models where total params exceed one GPU but active params do not.
rule: Measure all-to-all bandwidth first - it is the MoE scaling ceiling.
failureModes: Hot-expert stragglers; capacity overflow dropping tokens.
